# queuekit

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/kit/queuekit"
```

Package queuekit is what framework/kit/queue plugs into kit: the brokers kit's consumers' queues run on — the SDK's queue in memory, in the data directory and over SQL, a mailer's outbox on a database sealed in front of the SQL one —, the consumer that delivers them, and the migration of a queue's table (ADR 0179 §1, step 4). kit's core imports none of the SDK's queue: it reaches it through plug, and a product that declares no topic, no subscription, no watch, no queued command and no outbox on a database links none of it.

Package queuekit — the compile-time proof that the brokers are kit's.
